candidate_adjudication.reason: The existing candidate directly matches FARA sorts but extensional tuple identity collapses distinct parallel relation occurrences. Reifying occurrences repairs the defect and yields the selected kernel.

Typed nodes and identity-bearing hyperedges preserve the required commitments, but universal node/port/hyperedge machinery fixes an encoding style not required by FARA. It is retained as an exact derived view.

Bare transition algebra makes operation and execution structure foundational and does not natively preserve source/representation, interpretation, provenance, or occurrence identity. A charged sidecar makes it an admissible operational backend.

Typed disjoint carriers directly realize FARA categories; identity-bearing Event and RelationOccurrence carriers preserve repeated occurrences; operational semantics remain in the declared calculus or FARO layer.

conclusion: For Project FAR v1.0, FARA's canonical formal foundation is the identity-bearing many-sorted relational kernel. Typed-hypergraph and algebraic/state-transition forms are admissible derived views when their translations and required sidecars are explicit and commitment-preserving.
